title: Comparison and quantification of estrogen receptor-mediated responsiveness to endocrine disruptors in bivalves by using complementary model and a novel yeast assay approach.
authors: Liu, Liru; Miao, Jingjing; Liu, Peipei; Zhao, Anran; Yao, Linlin; Pan, Luqing
one_liner_zh: 该文用分子对接模拟预测双壳类雌激素受体与配体结合，并构建酵母报告系统验证转录激活，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作（ERE）但核心是配体-受体结合，方法以对接和实验为主，与TF-DNA特异性结合建模课题部分相关。
abstract: Endocrine disrupting chemicals (EDCs) in estuaries and coastal habitats have been widely detected over the world and caused global concern. Bivalves have been shown to be vulnerable to endocrine disruption. However, estrogen receptors (ERs) sensitivity to steroids and EDCs has long been considered to be restricted to vertebrates. In the present study, a computational simulation docking model was applied to qualitatively predict the binding behavior of two bivalve ERs to estradiol and compared the docking activity with zebra fish ERa. A novel reconstituted yeast system was constructed by using transcriptional activator GAL-4 consists of ER-expressing plasmid and ERE (estrogen responsive element)-containing plasmid. The assays showed that bivalve ER specifically activate transcription in response to tested steroids and EDCs, but the activation ability is weaker compared to zebra fish ERa. The results corroborate the presence of an active ER in bivalve molluscs and provide a promising tool for screening of marine environmental pollutants active in disturbing ERs of bivalves, as well as understanding the underlying mechanism across taxonomic groups and phyla.
abstract_zh: 河口和沿海栖息地中的内分泌干扰化学物质（EDCs）已在全球范围内被广泛检出，并引起全球关注。双壳类动物已被证明易受内分泌干扰影响。然而，雌激素受体（ERs）对类固醇和EDCs的敏感性长期以来被认为仅限于脊椎动物。本研究采用计算模拟对接模型，定性预测两种双壳类ER与雌二醇的结合行为，并与斑马鱼ERa的对接活性进行比较。通过使用由ER表达质粒和含ERE（雌激素响应元件）质粒组成的转录激活因子GAL-4，构建了一种新型重组酵母系统。检测表明，双壳类ER在响应测试的类固醇和EDCs时特异性激活转录，但激活能力弱于斑马鱼ERa。结果证实了双壳类软体动物中存在活性ER，并为筛选干扰双壳类ER的海洋环境污染物以及理解跨分类群和门类的潜在机制提供了有前景的工具。
